name: Shimokawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shimokawa town emblem in white: a stylised character with horn-like upper strokes and a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Shimokawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 December 1958.

features.role: Shimokawa town emblem — a stylised character with horn-like upper strokes and a ring
